bar.name: v1 HTML fixtures and A2UI for the same apps; 300 blind English requests; independent end-to-end attack on stored rows

biggest_gap: A same-type swap or rotation written with `was` is re-applied on every reload or re-submit, so values flip silently while diff says safe. Restoring an older backup after an option rename, and Undo after re-editing back to the original text, both strand rows on the wrong option.

acceptance.line: >= 90% of 300 blind requests expressible (programs parse and type-check)
acceptance.evidence: All 330 corpus and example programs check; COVERAGE.md 237 of 256 in-scope (92.6%). Critic wrote 8 programs from SPEC only, all 8 run. Not expressible: list-valued let, else if, fractional duration literals.
300 corpus programs, keyword tokenizer: median 133, p90 239, max 811.

acceptance.line: every prefix cut at a line end parses
acceptance.evidence: Prefix test passes inside 522/522; fuzz-check 20,000 mutations on a fresh seed: 0 crashes, 0 grammar disagreements.

acceptance.line: edits never lose or retype saved data while marked safe
acceptance.evidence: S1: `b num was a, a num was b` flips values on each reload or re-submit, marked safe (also 3-cycles, setting swaps, option swaps). S2: restore(old snapshot) after option rename leaves rows on the old option; rename, re-edit to original text, Undo twice strands rows.

other_notes: Fixed and re-tested by the critic: setting default no longer overwrites a saved value; load never throws on 28 corrupt shapes; charts plot oldest-first; money keeps precision (EMI correct); name constraint 0 false refusals over 17,963 positions, median 0.03 ms.
Evaluator truth: 12 programs matched hand calculation on windows, month ends, year boundaries, money and reminders. No wrong result found.

S3: corrupt optionLog throws later in applyEdit/revert; reused table name brings back old rows; a diff note says a dropped option stays filterable but the checker refuses it; m:ss and h:mm look the same; constraint lets `all` through where `it` stood (2.3%); 8 same-meaning spellings remain.
